About

ACM-W NITK — Empowering Women in Technology.

ACM-W NITK is the student chapter of the Association for Computing Machinery — Women at the National Institute of Technology Karnataka, Surathkal. We are dedicated to supporting and celebrating women in computing, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive in technology.

Through events, mentorship, workshops, and networking, we work to bridge the gender gap in tech and inspire the next generation of women leaders in computing.

Join us on our journey to make computing a more inclusive, diverse, and welcoming space for all.

At ACM-W we're all ears. Feel free to drop in your feedback or suggestions — we'd love to hear from you. Leave us a mail or connect with us on our social media accounts.
